page0.text:
I'm no match for this Servant.
Then, with my free left arm, I should call for the one who can beat her.
I don't even know how to consciously use it.
But it responded once before, so if I really put my mind to it...!

page1.text:
"Ungh... PLEASE COME, SABER...!"
My field of vision is covered in light.
It might be because I used the Command Spell, but I feel an intense pain in my left hand.
Snict, splat.
I hear a fleshy noise followed by the sound of blood splattering. Pain again shoots through my hand.

page2.text:
"...Haah..."
When I open my eyes...
"Aaaaaaahhhhhh....!!!???"
The Command Spell fades from...my...hand...

page3.text:
"Ugh... Hrrk...ah, ahhhhhh...!!!"
An involuntary howl escapes my throat.
Just as I lose command of my voice, the pain in my limb spikes beyond my control.

page4.text:
"...Ah, yes, congratulations. You were bound to use your Command Spell if I kept your left hand free.
You were babbling nonsense earlier, but you are no different from other Masters when cornered. You're just a human who binds a Servant with that curse."

page5.text:
"Ungh... Hnng, ah, hah...!"
...It won't stop.
The blood gushing from my left arm won't stop.
With a wound this big, it'll never stop...!

page6.text:
"To make you use your Command Spell... In this hunt, I have fulfilled the condition that I set for myself.
And the other would be to gouge your eyes out... But I shall spare you from that. I am more than satisfied just from hearing your cries of anguish. I will surely find the peak of my delight if I gouge your eyes out as well."

page7.text:
"Ha... Ah, ah, ha..."
The bleeding...won't stop.
My consciousness fades.
Before that, before I really die... I have to call for Saber... With my Command Spell...

page8.text:
"That is enough bleeding. Originally, I was going to gouge your chest out and end your life, but I shall hold back in honor of the fact that you put up a good fight.
Archer's Master should arrive soon. You may survive if you are lucky... But your brain will likely not be able to function normally even if you do."

page10.text:
I don't feel any pain.
I bleed while suspended in midair.
Saber. I...have...to call...Saber...
